validationPassword:
Attention: Your password must meet the following criteria:
  • Be 8 to 10 characters long.
  • Contain at least one uppercase letter and one lowercase letter.
  • Include at least one number and one special character (e.g. @$!%*?&.,).
To ensure the security of your account, make sure your password meets these criteria. A strong password is essential to protect your personal data and privacy online.

mfa_page_description_text_1: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds an extra layer of protection to your account by requiring not just your password, but also an additional verification step—such as a code from your phone or email.This significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, even if your password gets compromised.
mfa_page_description_text_2: By enabling MFA, you’re taking a proactive step toward securing your personal data, protecting sensitive company resources, and complying with modern security best practices.Choose one or more verification methods below to get started.
mfa_page_back_button: Back to Account Settings
mfa_page_setup_card_text: Choose one of the available apps to generate time-based codes. You can scan the QR code or manually enter the secret key.
mfa_page_setup_success_text: You have successfully added a new multi-factor authentication method. You can now use it to enhance the security of your account during login.
hero_desc: Modern platform for Identity & Access Management (IAM), OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect federation, and advanced protection with JWT and JWE encryption.
bento_zero_trust_desc: Continuous protection and RBAC role segregation
bento_oauth_desc: Token Exchange, Authorization Code and PKCE support
bento_mfa_desc: Biometric verification, TOTP, and security email
settings_subtitle: Customize appearance, branding, language, color themes, and manage Access Sphere backup & restore
settings_card_lang_desc: Choose interface language. Automatically detected from your browser upon startup.
settings_card_theme_desc: Select one of the 6 color palettes. The entire interface updates immediately.
settings_card_login_desc: Choose between the features showcase (Photo 1) or a custom dimmed wallpaper background.
settings_card_brand_desc: Change the application name, logo, and favicon to fully white-label the platform.
settings_card_backup_desc: Export all Access Sphere data (users, OAuth clients, settings) to a JSON file or restore a previous snapshot.
restore_warning: Warning: restoring will update users, clients, and settings from the selected file.
dash_welcome_desc: Real-time overview of the identity and security infrastructure. Choose below whether to manage Users directory or configure OAuth 2.0 Clients.
dash_choose_area_desc: Select the console you want to access to manage users or client applications.
dash_hub_users_desc: Complete directory, credential management, RBAC roles, account lock/unlock, and two-factor authentication (MFA) configuration.
dash_hub_clients_desc: Configuration of authorized applications, JWT/JWE keys, grant types, redirect URIs, secret management, and system auditing.
